subject.title: Surface internal system messages in a distinct UI block instead of normal chat bubbles

question: Should runtime-origin messages be hidden by default, shown as distinct diagnostic blocks, or split by explicit audience/kind metadata across WebChat and TUI?
rationale: Current main has partial fixes and UI primitives, but the correct behavior depends on maintainer intent for transparency versus hiding agent-only orchestration text.

options.title: Audience metadata first
options.body: Add or reuse explicit message audience/kind metadata, hide agent-only continuations, and render visible runtime/system events in a distinct block.

options.title: Visual-only treatment
options.body: Keep current visibility semantics and add a dedicated system block style for role=system messages in Control UI and TUI.

options.title: Close as fixed by filtering
options.body: Treat the pre-compaction fix as sufficient and route remaining continuation/system-event cases to narrower issues only.

recommendation.title: Audience metadata first
recommendation.body: Add or reuse explicit message audience/kind metadata, hide agent-only continuations, and render visible runtime/system events in a distinct block.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved decision is primarily Control UI/WebChat presentation, and Shakker has recent chat UI history plus issue-routing signal.
